reexpress.title: Too Small to Bother
reexpress.asserts: Being unattractive to large capital is the protection, not a weakness.
reexpress.not_covered: Does not address the demand-risk half — that most small apps still fail to earn meaningfully (70% under $1,000/month).

reexpress.title: The 400x Problem Nobody Covers
reexpress.asserts: Highlights the extreme payout gap between top and bottom performers.
reexpress.not_covered: Omits the floor-related good news — that viable small software businesses are increasing 55% and now majority of publishers.

reexpress.title: Software Is Going Where the Barber Went
reexpress.asserts: Software is becoming a small, local-scale trade rather than a venture-scale industry.
reexpress.not_covered: Does not mention the distribution and platform-dependency risk (App Store delistings) that still threatens even small, trade-like software businesses.
